function.name: get_claim_status
function.description: Read the verified caller's claims. Call it when a verified caller asks about their claims: with no detail for a short summary (it names the claims it reads and says how many more are on file); with detail documents when they want to hear what documents are needed and how to send them; with detail claim and claim_ending for more about one claim, such as why it was denied, how to appeal, when it was paid or who the adjuster is; with detail claim and no claim_ending when they ask about the other claims on file or have not said which claim. Call it again for each new question: never answer about a claim from memory or from an earlier result. The account comes from the verified call, never from the caller. Its result is the sentence for the caller: already spoken, or read out word for word when spoken is false.

detail.description: summary (the default) for where each claim stands; documents for what the claims waiting on documents need, by when and how to send them; claim for everything about the one claim claim_ending names.

claim_ending.description: With detail claim: the claim the caller means: the last digits written as digits (198), the claim type word they used (auto, home or property), or both (home 198). When they point to a claim by its place in the summary they just heard (the first one, the second one), pass that claim's last three digits from the summary: passing them is not answering from memory. Leave it out when they have not said which.

messages.content: Alright, let me pull up your claims.
Thanks for bearing with me, almost there.
Sorry, I'm having trouble pulling up your claims right now. I can have a representative call you back, or you can try again in a few minutes. Which would you prefer?
